svg.title: Fraud Shield prediction workflow flowchart
svg.desc: End-to-end flowchart of the Fraud Shield prediction pipeline, from transaction input through feature engineering, ML scoring, risk calculation, alert generation, and analyst verification.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does single transaction monitoring work in Fraud Shield?')
sendPrompt('How does CSV batch upload fraud detection work in Fraud Shield?')
sendPrompt('What fields does parse_transaction validate in Fraud Shield?')
g.text: scoring_service.parse_transaction() — validate required fields, amount, date, time format

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does Fraud Shield load and manage customer behavior profiles?')
sendPrompt('What behavior signals does Fraud Shield analyze and how are behavior points calculated?')
g.text: analyze_behavior() — new device, new country, amount spike, rapid velocity

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What are the 15 model features engineered in Fraud Shield and how are they computed?')
sendPrompt('How does the StandardScaler work in Fraud Shield and why is it needed?')
g.text: scaler.transform() using fitted scaler.pkl — zero mean, unit variance

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the Random Forest model predict fraud probability in Fraud Shield?')
g.text: model.predict_proba() using fraud_model.pkl — 200 trees, balanced class weight

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How is the fraud probability threshold determined and applied in Fraud Shield?')
g.text: probability ≥ 0.449 → Fraud (1), else Normal (0) — tuned on validation F2-score

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How is the risk score calculated in Fraud Shield and what are its components?')
g.text: ML × 0.72 + flag(+10) + behavior_points(≤28) → Low / Medium / High / Critical

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does Fraud Shield create and store alerts for suspicious transactions?')
sendPrompt('How does Fraud Shield update customer behavior profiles after a transaction?')
sendPrompt('Where does Fraud Shield persist transaction records and what is saved?')
g.text: save_state() → instance/data_store.json — label, prob, risk, behavior, preprocessing
